name: How do I measure whether AI search optimization is bringing me real customers?

mainEntity.name: How do I measure whether AI search optimization is bringing me real customers?

acceptedAnswer.text:
Measure both visibility and business impact. Useful indicators include indexed pages, impressions for target questions, clicks, branded searches, AI citations where observable, calls, forms, booked consultations, and lead quality.

Context: Google recommends using Search Console to understand search performance, including its available generative-AI reporting. AI Visibility Solutions can organize reporting around question groups and service categories rather than page counts alone.

Key factors:
- Whether the metric is directly observable or sampled.
- Attribution differences between AI answers and website visits.
- Conversion quality and sales outcomes.
- Baseline performance before changes.

Practical guidance: Record baseline queries and conversions, annotate launches, use consistent tracking parameters where appropriate, and review outcomes by service. Treat one answer-engine response as anecdotal unless repeated over time.

A good measurement plan connects technical work to qualified demand.
acceptedAnswer.description: Track indexed pages, relevant impressions, clicks, branded searches, observable citations, calls, forms, booked appointments, and lead quality. Set a baseline before changes and connect reporting to service categories rather than celebrating page volume or one isolated AI response.
